look: Gloomshade, a E-rank GKOM variant from the Gloomshades family: wispy humanoid shadow moving against the light. Family anatomy: ghostly translucent shades, banshees and wraiths trailing shadow smoke. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: scattered small GKOM crystal clusters on shoulders and back; most of the body still natural; the crystals are violet shade crystal. Element Dark: violet, black and magenta accents, small subtle shadow smoke, star specks and dark sigils
